meta.source_provenance: Email from PC Jon Dixon to Ben Carter on 4 Nov 2024 at 15:39 (provided by user)

emails.subject_summary: Follow-up: NICE link already sent; promises to resend
emails.body:
Hi Ben
Checking our systems it’s showing that a link has already been sent to you. I will send a further one, please check your spam box if you can’t find either.
Regards
PC DIXON EA817

sentence_tags.text: Checking our systems it’s showing that a link has already been sent to you.
sentence_tags.notes: Police system shows link sent, but unclear if victim received or could use it.

sentence_tags.text: I will send a further one, please check your spam box if you can’t find either.
sentence_tags.notes: Promise of resolution; later failures to deliver links contradict this assurance.

contradiction_links.claim: Police provided victim with adequate means to submit evidence.
contradiction_links.reality: Despite promise to resend links, Ben later reports upload limits and missing links.

events: Police claim NICE link already sent; promise to send another.
Marks beginning of recurring issue with evidence upload barriers.

damages_summary.emotional: Ben left uncertain if police systems aligned with his access to upload evidence.
damages_summary.strategic: Promise to resend link sets expectation of smooth process; later failures heighten contradiction.
